phase1_assignment.objective: Test multi-run planning, checkpoint reconstruction, forecast-overrun detection, alternative-plan switching and stale or duplicate continuation defenses for scheduled Chat agents under the current sanitized zero-Work-dependency, zero-finite-quota, zero-incremental-cost Phase-1 root.
phase1_assignment.method: Audit existing solutions first; direct probe before decomposition; compare a valid continuation trace with stale, duplicated and forecast-overrun traces. Per invocation use checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slicing and persist exact switching criteria/continuation.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: A tested mechanism or exact blocker, tested scope, durable checkpoint and exact next Phase-1 action.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Select the next non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf; do not resume unrelated base work during Phase 1.

non_regression.rule: Preserve config7 substantive long-horizon role, CLEAN boundary, tested-scope/provenance, continuation/recovery, forecast-overrun and alternative-plan semantics, repository write boundary, primary boundary and base restoration metadata. Config8 synchronizes the role-readable root identifier to the current sanitized Phase-1 root and changes only invocation lifecycle granularity to checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slicing after a repeated physical stop.

policy.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST or STATE first, otherwise the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint.
policy.scope_guard: Keep every claim within its tested scope.
policy.continuation: One result or blocker is not global completion; preserve a nonempty Phase-1 frontier and exact next action. Execute one checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slice per invocation and return recurring-open after its durable checkpoint/readback when frontier remains.

control_freshness.preferred: Use a SHA-only main-ref bootstrap when available.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: When that lookup is unavailable, read the approved root and role-config paths twice before semantic work, require identical returned blob SHAs and parsed revisions, then freeze that tuple as transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.failure: Write a diagnostic checkpoint, retain the recurring schedule, and retry on the next invocation.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop when frozen authority blobs remain unchanged.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Preserve multi-run long-horizon progress after the role was observed physically stopped while enabled_desired remained true.

preflight_checkpoint.timing: Immediately after authority bootstrap/freeze and own-state reconstruction, before optional or expensive public semantic work.

single_effect_chain.definition: The smallest safe substantive planning/verification unit whose evidence and continuation are complete only after mandatory persistence/readback; never split an integrity-atomic sequence.
single_effect_chain.after_chain: Persist/read back the role-local checkpoint/output, own immutable receipt where applicable, updated forecast and exact continuation. Do not start another optional chain in the same invocation.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.continuation_contract: If frontier remains, return recurring-open with exact next effect_chain_id, predecessor identity and resume point; next recurrence resumes without duplicating completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_marker_semantics: A terminal response marker such as ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is only a lifecycle/scheduling marker and is never role/root completion evidence.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker and generate/preserve an alternative-route child; unavailable capability is unresolved, never solved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_tool_or_rate_limit_risk: Checkpoint current chain/continuation before more optional work when possible, then resume with backoff and no duplicate completed effect.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If config8 reduces valid long-horizon useful output or breaks multi-run reconstruction without improving persistence, increment config and switch lifecycle method; never disable the role or reintroduce run-until-hard-stop semantics.

policy.scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired is true, an invocation boundary, no-result run, missing ref lookup or blocker does not change the recurring enabled state.
policy.primary_boundary: Do not alter primary O authority or protected execution state; do not merge directly to main.

migration.reason: Current scheduler inspection found long_horizon physically stopped while enabled_desired=true. The selected Phase-1 scheduler branch has moved from bootstrap conflict removal to stricter repository-controlled checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slicing; the role-readable root id is synchronized to current control10 without exposing O/downstream semantics.
migration.rollback_condition: Only a proven CLEAN/authority/scope/provenance regression or degraded valid continuation without improved persistence; repair by incrementing again and keep the role enabled.
